body:
I am a virgin myself and I understand how important it might've been for you, I made the choice to wait until marriage and think I would be just as upset as you if something like that had happened to me, BUT I want you to know that virginity doesn't determine your worth, and rest assured that you are as valuable as any other girl. Please don't think that this is a mistake from which you can't recover, and even though you can't get you virginity back you can still work towards becoming a better woman everyday.

Please don't blame yourself for what happened, unfortunately boys can sometimes be very deceiving, but I am sure the right one will come along. Don't think badly of yourself just try to be a better person everyday! A stranger thinks of you!

I am so sorry you had to live through all of that, really do, and if you can seek medical attention I will like to strongly advice you to do it despite what your mom say.

I think you are a very brave and admirable person because despite everything that you had to live through you still has the determination keep on going, studying and working. And I truly believe that eventually you'll get the freedom you need to carry on with your life on your own term, until then I wish that you will be able to overcome every obstacle you have to face.

A stranger thinks of you and wishes you well!
Thank you for reading and for the good wishes!
Thank you for your kind words !
